raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

A long conversation can be sent to a different prefill DP rank on its next turn even when its previous prefix is still resident. In the original 300 s first-token control, all 12 timeouts changed P shard. Seventeen successful requests changed shard too. This PR makes session reuse an explicit placement policy.

## Modifications

- Add the opt-in `--load-balance-method prefill_session_tokens` for a PD prefill engine. Place new sessions using estimated prompt/output footprint, live token load and per-rank KV capacity. Planning slots are advisory and fall back to projected load when full.
- Prefer the session’s active rank on later turns, honor explicit rank overrides, and bound the reservation history by time and size. Native KV admission still owns allocation. Existing load-balancing policies keep their behavior.

## Accuracy Tests

The measured feature commit was `9edb89b3c468`. The submission head `66e61905995c` merges the fixed upstream `40a64e1b5ba0`. Its complete Git tree was verified to equal applying the measured PR patch to that upstream commit.

The controller, load snapshots and argument validation passed **70 tests** on Linux arm64 CPU. Cases cover rank overrides, inactive ranks, unequal or missing capacity, prompt growth, bounded history, and dispatch after slots fill.

```sh
python3 -m pytest -q test/registered/unit/managers/test_data_parallel_controller.py test/registered/unit/managers/test_load_snapshot_backends.py test/registered/unit/server_args/test_server_args.py::TestLoadBalanceMethod
```

A real four-host PD conversation returned 323 for 17 × 19, then 324 when asked to add one to its previous answer. This exercise covers request routing and conversation handoff. A broad model-quality suite was not run.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

In both candidate replays all **48/48** adjacent formal-turn pairs stayed on the same P rank, versus **8/48** and **12/48** in the controls. Uncached prompt tokens per replay fell from **5.10–5.11 million** to **136,571–138,224**. P H2D volume increased to **319.64–328.35 GiB**. Against the mean of both controls, mean TTFT fell **90.7%** and aggregate output throughput rose **9.42×**. D decoding slowed as more requests decoded concurrently, with unchanged D code and settings. [Placement microbenchmark](https://github.com/INBreezefall/sglang/tree/682f1c33931c4b8c0ab11df9d0236d00ff06fcfb/benchmark/ascend_a2_pd_evidence).

GLM-5.2 W4A8C8 ran on four hosts with eight Ascend 910B4-1 NPUs each, CANN 9.1.0 and torch-npu 2.10.0.post6. P and D each used TP16 and attention DP8. Every arm used SGLang `40a64e1b5ba0` with the same A2 C8 / Mooncake compatibility fixes. Each row contains all 72 responses from the same 24 sessions × three closed-loop turns, after 24 warm-ups. Temperature was 0, output was capped at 256 tokens, and retries were disabled.

| Arm | Mean TTFT (s) | P95 TTFT (s) | Client decode (tok/s per request, valid n/72) | D decode (tok/s) | Output TPS (tok/s) |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| Control 1 | 296.74 | 620.25 | 94.71 (53) | 36.41 | 9.47 |
| Restored control | 272.47 | 580.21 | 119.61 (57) | 45.99 | 9.31 |
| PR run 1 | 28.47 | 59.80 | 36.18 (66) | 15.07 | 81.34 |
| PR run 2 | 24.64 | 46.58 | 60.80 (48) | 26.66 | 95.62 |

Client decode averages valid semantic streaming spans. The PD relay can buffer output. D decode is the inverse of token-weighted server ITL, covering every post-first token interval. Output TPS counts actual output tokens over the formal wall window. The complete comparison allowed 1,200 s for the first token and 300 s between subsequent events. A separate original 300 s control completed 38 of 50 attempted requests before its stop policy withheld 22. [Protocol and anonymized per-request results](https://github.com/INBreezefall/sglang/tree/26bc7bdac9a4158319a7d3d8e3cd10218072bb05/benchmark/ascend_a2_pd_evidence/c24).

- [x] Added or updated registered unit tests for the changed paths.
- [x] Updated the relevant option documentation.
- [x] Reported correctness checks, repeated hardware measurements, and regressions.
- [x] Checked the changed files against the project code-style guidance.

+"""Soft session affinity for DP ranks inside a prefill engine."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import time
+from collections import OrderedDict
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+
+
+@dataclass(slots=True)
+class _Session:
+    rank: int
+    peak_input: int
+    footprint: int
+    slot: int | None
+    last_seen: float
+
+
+class PrefillSessionPlacement:
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        num_ranks: int,
+        *,
+        slots_per_rank: int = 3,
+        max_sessions: int = 4096,
+        idle_seconds: int = 1800,
+    ):
+        if not 0 <= slots_per_rank <= 32:
+            raise ValueError(
+                "prefill session planning slots per rank must be between 0 and 32"
+            )
+        if max_sessions < 1 or idle_seconds < 1:
+            raise ValueError(
+                "prefill session history needs a positive size and timeout"
+            )
+        self.sessions: OrderedDict[str, _Session] = OrderedDict()
+        self.retained = [0] * num_ranks
+        self.occupied = [set() for _ in range(num_ranks)]
+        self.slots_per_rank = slots_per_rank
+        self.max_sessions = max_sessions
+        self.idle_seconds = idle_seconds
+
+    def _remove(self, session_id: str) -> _Session:
+        session = self.sessions.pop(session_id)
+        self.retained[session.rank] -= session.footprint
+        if session.slot is not None:
+            self.occupied[session.rank].remove(session.slot)
+        return session
+
+    def drop_ranks(self, ranks: set[int]) -> None:
+        for key in [
+            key for key, session in self.sessions.items() if session.rank in ranks
+        ]:
+            self._remove(key)
+
+    def _cold_slot(self, ranks, footprint, live_tokens, capacity):
+        # Uniformly spaced small-to-large targets sum to each rank's capacity.
+        # Account for the error of earlier placements in the remaining targets.
+        count = self.slots_per_rank
+        best = None
+        for rank in ranks:
+            free = [s for s in range(count) if s not in self.occupied[rank]]
+            if not free:
+                continue
+            cap = capacity[rank]
+            mean = cap / count
+            targets = [
+                mean if count == 1 else mean * (2 + 2 * s / (count - 1)) / 3
+                for s in free
+            ]
+            used = max(self.retained[rank], live_tokens[rank])
+            deviation = (used + sum(targets) - cap) / len(free)
+            for slot, target in zip(free, targets):
+                error = abs(footprint - target + deviation) / cap
+                score = (error, len(self.occupied[rank]), used / cap, rank, slot)
+                if best is None or score < best:
+                    best = score
+        return (best[-2], best[-1]) if best is not None else (None, None)
+
+    def select(
+        self,
+        session_id: str | None,
+        input_tokens: int,
+        output_tokens: int,
+        active: list[int],
+        live_tokens: list[int],
+        live_requests: list[int],
+        capacity: list[int],
+        forced_rank: int | None = None,
+    ) -> int:
+        if not active:
+            raise RuntimeError("No active DP workers are available for prefill.")
+        now = time.monotonic()
+        while self.sessions:
+            key, oldest = next(iter(self.sessions.items()))
+            if now - oldest.last_seen < self.idle_seconds:
+                break
+            self._remove(key)
+
+        previous = self._remove(session_id) if session_id in self.sessions else None
+        peak = max(input_tokens, previous.peak_input) if previous else input_tokens
+        growth = peak - previous.peak_input if previous else 0
+        # Project one observed turn of growth and this request's output allowance.
+        footprint = peak + growth + output_tokens
+        if session_id and len(self.sessions) >= self.max_sessions:
+            self._remove(next(iter(self.sessions)))
+
+        normalize = all(capacity[r] > 0 for r in active)
+        slot = None
+        rank = forced_rank
+        if rank is None and previous is not None and previous.rank in active:
+            rank = previous.rank
+        candidates = active
+        if rank is None and normalize:
+            fitting = [
+                r
+                for r in active
+                if max(self.retained[r], live_tokens[r]) + footprint <= capacity[r]
+            ]
+            candidates = fitting or active
+        if previous is not None and rank == previous.rank:
+            slot = previous.slot
+        if session_id and normalize and self.slots_per_rank and slot is None:
+            slot_rank, slot = self._cold_slot(
+                [rank] if rank is not None else candidates,
+                footprint,
+                live_tokens,
+                capacity,
+            )
+            if rank is None:
+                rank = slot_rank
+        if rank is None:
+            # Use raw token counts until every active rank has reported capacity.
+            def score(r):
+                used = max(self.retained[r], live_tokens[r])
+                projected = used + footprint
+                if normalize:
+                    projected = (used + min(footprint, capacity[r])) / capacity[r]
+                return projected, live_requests[r], r
+
+            rank = min(candidates, key=score)
+
+        if session_id:
+            estimate = min(footprint, capacity[rank]) if capacity[rank] else footprint
+            self.sessions[session_id] = _Session(rank, peak, estimate, slot, now)
+            self.retained[rank] += estimate
+            if slot is not None:
+                self.occupied[rank].add(slot)
+        return rank
